note_text: Bilateral digital mammography with tomosynthesis. Right breast: 4.9 cm irregular hypoechoic mass at the upper outer quadrant. Axilla: no abnormal lymph node. Contralateral breast: no suspicious finding. Impression: BI-RADS 4C. Recommend ultrasound-guided core needle biopsy.

CT chest, abdomen and pelvis with contrast. Right breast mass 4.9 cm. No significant lymphadenopathy. No distant metastasis. Impression: breast cancer, cT2N0M0.
Whole body FDG PET-CT. Hypermetabolic right breast mass (SUVmax 4.5). No significant lymphadenopathy. No distant metastasis.

Breast, right, total mastectomy with sentinel lymph node biopsy: Invasive ductal carcinoma, NOS. Tumor size 1.7 cm. Lymphovascular invasion: absent. Resection margins: negative margin (>= 2 mm). Lymph nodes: 0/5 positive. Pathologic stage yT1cyN0M0. Miller-Payne grade 4 (partial response).
